raw_text: Jane's Defence Weekly has confirmed through independent satellite imagery analysis that the People's Liberation Army has erected a modular bridge structure near Finger 8 on the northern bank of Pangong Tso in eastern Ladakh. The bridge, assessed to be approximately 30 metres in span, utilises Type-321 prefabricated steel panels consistent with PLA engineering corps standard equipment. Its positioning would allow rapid reinforcement of Chinese positions along the contested ridgeline, effectively shortening logistics routes by approximately 12 kilometres compared to the existing track network.
